what: When a bundle of small graphics like a school of fish or sea pieces crosses the 20% line at the bottom of the screen, it switches on once, each piece popping in from .8x scale and transparent with a random length between .4~.8s on quart.out. The delay between pieces is 20ms in order, so the school appears to spread from one side

options.min · max: Random range for piece length (sec), default .4 · .8
options.at: How many % past the top of the screen before it turns on, default 80
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Pieces to light up (SVG <g> may be) — if none, all children

from.where: shared.js·each page fish school (original data-scroll-trigger="js-scroll-fishes" — each .fish scale .8→1 · opacity 0→1, duration anime.random(400,800), delay 20ms×i, easeOutQuart, IntersectionObserver rootMargin 0 0 −20% 0)
